objective: Independently test whether Full EARS improves error-risk ranking over B1 on the frozen Internal Test without test-driven adaptation.

B1.training: final fit on 329 eligible fit claims

B2.training: final fit on 329 eligible fit claims

EARS.training: final fit on 329 eligible fit claims

final_training.target: y_error = int(frozen E1 predicted_claim_label != authentic SUPPORT/CONTRADICT label)
final_training.standard_deviation: population ddof=0; scale 1 for exact zero variance
final_training.categorical_encoding: F3 fixed two dummies with SUPPORT reference; no scaling
required_artifacts_before_test_access: final_risk_models.joblib containing B1/B2/EARS models and preprocessing objects
final_model_numeric_spec.json containing lossless scaler, coefficient, intercept and class-order values
final_model_manifest.json containing versions, training counts and SHA-256 hashes
final_training.serialization_consistency_check: scores from the joblib objects and lossless numeric specification must agree on all 329 fit rows within absolute tolerance 1e-12

phase3b_execution_order: verify all predecessor and Phase 3A hashes
fit B1, B2 and Full EARS on exactly 329 eligible fit claims
freeze scaler, coefficients, intercepts, metadata and model artifact hashes
verify no Internal Test content was accessed before model freeze
selectively deserialize exactly the 141 Internal Test claim IDs
run the unchanged E1 retrieval, sentence selection, NLI and aggregation pipeline
validate completeness and derive eligibility without exclusions
execute only preregistered secondary and sensitivity analyses
freeze all results and produce the Phase 3B report
stopping_conditions: any predecessor or Phase 3A frozen hash mismatch
final-training population is not exactly the frozen 329 eligible fit claims
any learned model fails to converge under the frozen solver configuration
Internal Test content was accessed before final-model artifact freeze
any eligible Internal Test claim lacks a complete E1 or B0/B1/B2/EARS risk output
feature schema or model dependency is incompatible with the frozen implementation
test results have already been inspected before the one-time primary evaluation
prohibitions: promote EARS_without_F4 to the primary method
use calibration, Internal Test, Dev or official Test labels for fitting
change retrieval, sentence selection, NLI or aggregation using test behavior
replace Internal Test with SciFact Dev
silently exclude failures or adverse cases
choose between Phase 2B and Phase 3B results based on favorability
